properties.popup_header: Water Sports: Swimming, SUP & ORU Kayaking
properties.popup_body:
Our popular Open Water Swimming is now open for the summer season. 

And alongside it SUP & ORU Kayaking.

In partnership with Love Open Water and Dragon Boat Events, residents, visitors and workers are invited to take a dip and explore by SUP and kayak in the beautiful clear waters of Eden Dock. Enjoy the views of the iconic One Canada Square and Newfoundland whilst swimming in our urban oasis. 

In October 2024, Eden Dock was launched, a reimagining of the historic Middle Dock revealing a waterfront oasis with interconnected pontoons and aquatic islands. 
Open Water Swimming, SUP & ORU kayaking  are the perfect opportunity to get a unique view of this lush planting and floating gardens.

How to Book a Swim

There will be early morning, lunchtime and evening slots available throughout the week. Please download the ACTiO app to view and book swim slots, these will be available to book from early June.

Swimmers will need to purchase a NOWCA membership  – granting them access to all 40+ NOWCA UK locations including Eden Dock.

Each individual swim session is then charged per swim at £9.50, or you can take part in the free NOWCA Swim event that will be offered to members regularly.

How to book a SUP or ORU

Pre-booking is essential via the Eventbrite platform which can be accessed online at https://www.eventbrite.com/o/dragon-boat-events 

Once you have selected a date and 1hr slot, you will be given the option to choose between either a Stand-Up Paddleboard (SUP) or an Oru Kayak.

Your session includes a demonstration and safety briefing before you launch onto the water for your Eden Dock exploration.

Water Testing

Both Canary Wharf Group and Love Open Water conduct regular testing in Eden Dock to ensure it is safe for bathing. 

Venue

Access to the water is from the pontoon next to Humble Grape on Mackenzie Walk, this is also where swimmers will find a changing room, toilets and shower to get ready for their swim. 

For venue and swim session updates, news and announcements, download the NOWCA Wild app and follow the venue swim group – LOW CANARY WHARF.

If you have any further questions please contact the team at Love Open Water  or Dragon Boat Events.

properties.name: Crate Brewery
properties.popup_body:
Crate Opening New Venue in Wood Wharf this October.

We’ve been keeping this one under wraps for a while… and we’re thrilled to finally share the news - we’re expanding! This October, we’re opening a brand-new Crate in the heart of Wood Wharf — bringing our signature pizzas, craft beers, and laid-back vibe to the area.

Our new home is at 14 Water Street, E14 5GX; just steps from the water’s edge, and a 5-minute walk from Canary Wharf station. It has all the ingredients of a classic Crate hangout - afternoon pints, post-work pizzas, and tasty nights soundtracked by DJs and record labels taking over the decks on Fridays and Saturdays. 

Craft beer and Pizza in Wood Wharf, the CRATE Way
The new space will serve up our iconic pizzas like Sage and Truffle, Spicy Salami, and Middle Eastern Lamb. And we’ll also be adding some Wood Wharf-only exclusives to the menu, so look out for some new ones to try (and maybe the return of some historical favourites).

On the taps, you’ll find our core craft beer range, small-batch one-offs and seasonal pours, plus guest drops from all over the craft beer world. 

Not in a beer mood? We’ve got you covered with refreshing Crate soda cocktails, and, wine on tap from Sustainable Wine Solutions, alongside a line up of other specialties to tickle your fancy.

Built by Us, For You
If you know us, you know we like to get hands on; and the refit of Wood Wharf is no different. The fit-out is being done almost entirely by the Crate crew, from the initial demolition, to building the custom banquettes and light installations. We’re completely re-imagining a space, giving it the same stripped-back, hand-crafted feel you’ll recognise from Hackney Wick, but with its own personality that fits right into the new neighbourhood.

Our sustainability minded approach will of course weave itself through Crate Wood Wharf, with Foresso tabletops made from recycled timber terrazzo, Notpla seaweed boards for our pizzas, and wine on tap from returnable kegs. 

Once we’re open, two huge bi-fold doors will be installed, opening the space onto our enclosed garden; which will have room for up to 80 guests to hang out, drink down, and soak up the views.

Same Crate. New neighbourhood. Fresh vibes.

A New Chapter for CRATE
13 years into the Crate story, we’re excited to venture into this new chapter. It’s been a long time coming, and we can’t wait to open the doors to our friends and community, old and new. 

'We can't wait to bring Crate to a new part of London. We feel so lucky to have built an incredible community in Hackney Wick, then we found a space in Wood Wharf that we fell in love with, and wanted to bring the authentic Crate vibe to. The whole family has chipped in for an ‘all hands on deck’ situation to renovate as much of the space as we can by ourselves, the true Crate way!'. - Jess, Founding Director.

Our new home in Wood Wharf opens October 2025 at 14 Water Street, London E14 5GX.

properties.name: Jamaica Patty Co.
properties.popup_body:
Jamaican Patties are an incredibly popular savoury treat eaten across the whole of Jamaica and now widely available in other Caribbean islands,Canada and the USA.
The product and name are almost certainly derived from Cornish Pasties introduced to the island by Cornish sailors and settlers. Cornwall is one of the 3 counties that make up Jamaica to this day and contains many familiar place names such as Falmouth and Trelawny.
Traditional Jamaican Patties have a crispy pastry and crust usually made with Tumeric which gives the pastry it’s distinctive colour.
Beef,Chicken and Vegetables are probably the original fillings but over time patties in Jamaica have incorporated many other flavours including seafood and cheese. The filling is seasoned with, amongst other ingredients, mixed spices, Scallions, Thyme and Scotch Bonnet Peppers to give a unique flavour.

properties.name: Jamaica Patty Co.
properties.popup_body:
Jamaican Patties are an incredibly popular savoury treat eaten across the whole of Jamaica and now widely available in other Caribbean islands,Canada and the USA.
The product and name are almost certainly derived from Cornish Pasties introduced to the island by Cornish sailors and settlers. Cornwall is one of the 3 counties that make up Jamaica to this day and contains many familiar place names such as Falmouth and Trelawny.
Traditional Jamaican Patties have a crispy pastry and crust usually made with Tumeric which gives the pastry it’s distinctive colour.
Beef,Chicken and Vegetables are probably the original fillings but over time patties in Jamaica have incorporated many other flavours including seafood and cheese. The filling is seasoned with, amongst other ingredients, mixed spices, Scallions, Thyme and Scotch Bonnet Peppers to give a unique flavour.
Patties are eaten in Jamaica at any time of day or night and can be a main meal or just a snack.
JPC’s patties are made to a traditional recipe and baked in store to ensure an authentic experience.
As well as traditional flavours JPC has created Curried Goat,Jerk Chicken and Ackee & Saltfish patties so that UK consumers can experience the flavours of other Jamaican foods in patty form.

properties.name: Crate Brewery
properties.popup_body:
Crate Opening New Venue in Wood Wharf this October.

We’ve been keeping this one under wraps for a while… and we’re thrilled to finally share the news - we’re expanding! This October, we’re opening a brand-new Crate in the heart of Wood Wharf — bringing our signature pizzas, craft beers, and laid-back vibe to the area.

Our new home is at 14 Water Street, E14 5GX; just steps from the water’s edge, and a 5-minute walk from Canary Wharf station. It has all the ingredients of a classic Crate hangout - afternoon pints, post-work pizzas, and tasty nights soundtracked by DJs and record labels taking over the decks on Fridays and Saturdays. 

Craft beer and Pizza in Wood Wharf, the CRATE Way
The new space will serve up our iconic pizzas like Sage and Truffle, Spicy Salami, and Middle Eastern Lamb. And we’ll also be adding some Wood Wharf-only exclusives to the menu, so look out for some new ones to try (and maybe the return of some historical favourites).

On the taps, you’ll find our core craft beer range, small-batch one-offs and seasonal pours, plus guest drops from all over the craft beer world. 

Not in a beer mood? We’ve got you covered with refreshing Crate soda cocktails, and, wine on tap from Sustainable Wine Solutions, alongside a line up of other specialties to tickle your fancy.

Built by Us, For You
If you know us, you know we like to get hands on; and the refit of Wood Wharf is no different. The fit-out is being done almost entirely by the Crate crew, from the initial demolition, to building the custom banquettes and light installations. We’re completely re-imagining a space, giving it the same stripped-back, hand-crafted feel you’ll recognise from Hackney Wick, but with its own personality that fits right into the new neighbourhood.

Our sustainability minded approach will of course weave itself through Crate Wood Wharf, with Foresso tabletops made from recycled timber terrazzo, Notpla seaweed boards for our pizzas, and wine on tap from returnable kegs. 

Once we’re open, two huge bi-fold doors will be installed, opening the space onto our enclosed garden; which will have room for up to 80 guests to hang out, drink down, and soak up the views.

Same Crate. New neighbourhood. Fresh vibes.

A New Chapter for CRATE
13 years into the Crate story, we’re excited to venture into this new chapter. It’s been a long time coming, and we can’t wait to open the doors to our friends and community, old and new. 

'We can't wait to bring Crate to a new part of London. We feel so lucky to have built an incredible community in Hackney Wick, then we found a space in Wood Wharf that we fell in love with, and wanted to bring the authentic Crate vibe to. The whole family has chipped in for an ‘all hands on deck’ situation to renovate as much of the space as we can by ourselves, the true Crate way!'. - Jess, Founding Director.

Our new home in Wood Wharf opens October 2025 at 14 Water Street, London E14 5GX.

properties.name: Aesop
properties.popup_body:
Now open in Cabot Place…

Established in Melbourne in 1987, Aesop has since been formulating products with efficacy foremost in mind—their complex, distinctive aromas are but an incidental treat. The range now spans skin, hair and body care, as well as fragrance and accessories for the self and home. Some of the ingredients used are plant-based; others are laboratory-made; all are ethically sourced and have a proven record of safety. Aesop—a Certified B Corporation™—does not test its formulations or ingredients on animals. All Aesop products are vegan, Leaping Bunny approved, and included on PETA’s cruelty-free and vegan lists. They are available at aesop.com, in Aesop signature stores and department store counters, and from select like-minded retailers across the globe.

properties.name: Lockdown
properties.popup_body: Lockdown Bar & Restaurant is the neighbourhood spot for tasty food, great drinks & easy-going company. We pour East London craft beer, mix quality cocktails and serve a menu designed for sharing (including our famous smashed burgers). With a full calendar of music and events, the space is also available for exclusive hire.

properties.name: Bright Horizons Bank Street Day Nursery and Preschool
properties.popup_header: Bright Horizons Bank Street Day Nursery and Preschool
properties.popup_body:
Bank Street Day Nursery and Preschool (formally Little Unicorns) is based on the Canary Wharf complex within walking distance of the Canary Wharf Jubilee line station, ideally located for commuting parents and with buggy storage available.

Part of Bright Horizons Family, which received the Royal Society for the Prevention of Accidents (ROSPA) award in April 2016, Bank Street Nursery is located in a tranquil setting within the Canary Wharf complex.

The nursery offers a wide variety of engaging activities, which encourage children to learn and explore in a home from home environment. Children are well-prepared for the transition to school with the unique Bright Horizons Ready for School Programmes, including Growing Readers, Writers and Mathematicians.

properties.name: Hovarda
properties.popup_body:
Hovarda is thrilled to announce the upcoming launch of its second restaurant, Hovarda Canary Wharf, scheduled to open in a floating pavilion later this year.

With its origins in Soho in 2017, Hovarda has gained recognition for its Aegean-inspired cuisine. The soon-to-be 139-cover restaurant will feature a menu highlighting Aegean dishes, including signature items like red prawn orzo and traditional lamb kleftiko.

Designed by Cousi Interiorismo of Madrid, the stylish space will include a communal kitchen island and an eight-meter bar counter. In the evenings, international DJs will take the stage, making Hovarda Canary Wharf a future go-to destination for both dining and partying.The bar menu will offer a variety of classic and signature cocktails inspired by the coast of the Aegean.

properties.name: Royal China
properties.popup_body:
Royal China Riverside offers traditional Hong Kong Chinese dishes. The restaurant is renowned for its Dim Sum, which is served daily from Noon until 5pm and includes Steamed Seafood Dumplings with Spicy Sauce; and Pan-fried Fillet of Duck Breast Rolls. The restaurant dedicates a full page to signature dishes created by the restaurant's individual Head Chefs. These dishes are changed frequently, while the seasonal dishes are changed with the seasons. Set tasting menus are also available.

Royal China has elegant decor, contrasting rich golden hues with striking red and black features. Lacquered murals depicting an ornate Chinese illustration create a focal point within the restaurant.

The restaurant accommodates 130 people, while the large alfresco terrace overlooking the Thames seats 80 guests. Royal China Canary Wharf is a minute's walk from the Thames Clipper's Canary Wharf Pier.

On week days the restaurant is popular with business people, while weekends attract locals and families. The restaurant serves a traditional Hong Kong Chinese menu, perfect for guests wishing to indulge in authentic Chinese cuisine.

properties.name: Badiani Gelato
properties.popup_body:
The vibrant purple shop is Badiani’s latest addition to Canary Wharf within Cabot Place and is the perfect destination for those craving a sweet treat, an Italian coffee or one of their signature creative specialities such as their gelato croissant.

Established in Florence, Italy, in 1932, Badiani has been perfecting the art of artisanal ice cream for nearly a century. Badiani Cabot Place not only features classic favourites like Buontalenti, La Dolcevita, and Dark Chocolate Sorbet but also introduces their exclusive Coppa Gelato— a unique Badiani take on the classic gelato sundae.

At Badiani Cabot Place, you can enjoy a diverse array of sweet treats including cups and cones of gelato or sorbet, pinguinos, gelato cakes as well as gelato croissants and gelato burgers and more.

Pair their range of pastries with one of our Italian coffees, or indulge in a freshly made crepe. With a comfortable seating area, their shop is the perfect place to relax and enjoy these delights.

properties.name: BUPA
properties.popup_body: Bupa Health Care Canary Wharf is a first–of–its–kind health centre, bringing dentists, GPs, and consultants together under one roof. Located in the heart of London’s financial district, we’re open to everyone – whether you’re new to Bupa or already a patient, living or working nearby, insured or self–paying.

properties.name: 640 East
properties.popup_body:
A unique bar constructed from two shipping containers offering atmosphere alongside beer, champagne, cider, cocktails, wines, and soft drinks. Caravan Coffee Roasters also offer seasonal espresso blend and single origin coffee which is served all day long.

Artisan coffee producer Caravan source and roast the world's best beans from single farms and speciality estates in Ethiopia, Colombia and Rwanda. Served also is the "King of cold brew coffees" Sandows, pastries from Flour Station at Borough Market and Great Taste award-winning 70% cocoa Callebaut Belgium chocolate brownies from Galeta.

Private dining room is available to hire and the entire space is available for exclusive hire on the weekends. To book or to enquire about exclusive weekend hire please contact Adam Roughan on 07490 276 559 or email manager@640east.co.uk

properties.name: Manhattan Grill
properties.popup_body:
Great steaks... and that''s no bull! Set in a modern steakhouse ambience overlooking the Canary Wharf quay side, Manhattan Grill offers the ultimate steak for those meat lovers out there.

Our USDA beef comes from the great American plains and is grain-fed for 150 days for unique marbling, subtle texture and unsurpassed flavour. We also offer a wide variety of fine wines from South Africa, Chile, Argentina and France which can be bought by the bottle or by the glass, thanks to a high-tech wine preserving system.

Our G&Tea Lounge is a great place to meet with friends and colleagues for pre-dinner drinks. With a relaxed mood by day and a vibrant air by night, it is the ideal place for unwinding and recharging, or for an informal gathering after hours. Sample a few gins from our extensive collection of over 180 types, or join us for that quintessentially-British afternoon tea experience. The freshly-baked scones, delicious sandwiches and decadent pastries are to die for, and the Champagne toast is a must.
